name: User-selected compost / recycling / landfill policy
note: User-selected experimental sorting shortcut: food to compost; detected bottles and milk/juice cartons to recycling without checking whether empty; plates, utensils, wrappers, and hinged containers to review. Verified activates this owner-selected mapping only, not real-world disposal eligibility or independent accuracy.

food.instruction: Separate food from packaging and place food scraps in the compost bin.

plate.instruction: Check plate material, coating, contamination and local acceptance. Return reusable plates.

utensil.instruction: Return reusable utensils; identify disposable material and local acceptance.

hinged_container.instruction: Check whether the container is foam, rigid plastic, fiber or compostable, and whether it is accepted.

drink_carton.instruction: Recycling candidate under user-selected shortcut; carton contents are not checked. Prior school acceptance confirmation covered empty cartons only.

wrapper.instruction: Identify paper, film or foil and check local rules; this detector does not recognize wrapper material.

bottle.instruction: Recycling candidate under user-selected shortcut; bottle contents are not checked. Confirm local acceptance before actual disposal.

verification_basis: User explicitly requested automatic recycling for bottle and drink-carton detections without an emptiness check; previously confirmed school acceptance was for empty cartons only. This is an experimental sorting policy, not verified eligibility of filled containers.
local_acceptance_note: Carton acceptance was previously confirmed only for empty cartons. The new automatic suggestion does not establish acceptance of filled cartons or bottles.
